SLM Corp (NASDAQ:SLM) Institutional Investors Sentiment
May 14, 2018 - By Richard Conner Sentiment for SLM Corp (NASDAQ:SLM)
SLM Corp (NASDAQ:SLM) institutional sentiment decreased to 1.13 in 2017 Q4 . Its down -0.07, from 1.2 in 2017Q3. The ratio turned negative, as 124 investment professionals increased and started new stock positions, while 110 trimmed and sold holdings in SLM Corp. The investment professionals in our partner’s database now possess: 422.29 million shares, down from 424.24 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of investment professionals holding SLM Corp in their top 10 stock positions increased from 1 to 2 for an increase of 1. Sold All: 28 Reduced: 82 Increased: 78 New Position: 46.
SLM Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a saving, planning, and paying for college firm in the United States. The company has market cap of $5.02 billion. It offers private education loans to students and their families. It has a 18.61 P/E ratio. The firm also provides banking products, such as certificates of deposits, money market deposit accounts, and high yield savings accounts; and a consumer savings network that offers financial rewards on everyday purchases to help families save for college.
It closed at $11.54 lastly. It is down 8.86% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.41% the S&P500.
Fsi Group Llc holds 3.57% of its portfolio in SLM Corporation for 380,000 shares. Portolan Capital Management Llc owns 2.60 million shares or 3.22% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Philadelphia Financial Management Of San Francisco Llc has 3.21% invested in the company for 1.92 million shares. The Connecticut-based Discovery Capital Management Llc Ct has invested 2.43% in the stock. Monarch Partners Asset Management Llc, a Massachusetts-based fund reported 1.75 million shares.
Since January 1, 0001, it had 0 insider purchases, and 10 insider sales for $3.54 million activity. SLM Corporation (NASDAQ:SLM) Ratings Coverage
Ratings analysis reveals 83% of SLM Corporation’s analysts are positive. Out of 6 Wall Street analysts rating SLM Corporation, 5 give it “Buy”, 0 “Sell” rating, while 1 recommend “Hold”. The lowest target is $13.0 while the high is $17.0. The stock’s average target of $14.92 is 29.29% above today’s ($11.54) share price. SLM was included in 9 notes of analysts from December 21, 2017. BMO Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Thursday, January 18 report. Oppenheimer maintained SLM Corporation (NASDAQ:SLM) rating on Thursday, April 12. Oppenheimer has “Buy” rating and $1600 target. As per Monday, January 8, the company rating was initiated by Oppenheimer. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Wednesday, January 10 with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, January 4 with “Hold”. BMO Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Tuesday, April 24 report.
